meta.title: Erina Crafted — Interior Craftsmanship
meta.description: Erina Crafted makes custom interior elements — joinery, panelling, fitted kitchens and furniture — for rooms that ask for something considered.

hero.lede: Erina Crafted makes custom interior elements — joinery, panelling, fitted kitchens and furniture — for rooms that ask for something considered.

image.alt: Warm timber living room with a full-height wood feature wall and large windows

intro.label: The practice
intro.heading: We work closely with a small number of homes at a time, drawing, making and fitting each piece to the room it belongs to.
intro.body: Everything begins with the space: where the light falls, how a door opens, what the room is for. From there we develop details in timber, stone and metal — sampled, revised and made to measure.

studio.body: Erina Crafted is an interior craftsmanship practice working on custom solutions for residential interiors. The work sits between design and making: drawings developed with the client, samples made in the workshop, and installation handled with care for the finished room.
